## Codex capability boundary

This is source guidance, not an installed connector or a runtime proof. Resolve tools against the current host and read their actual schemas before using them. Preserve the named product and requested outcome. If a required operation is unavailable, report its exact name and leave that step incomplete. Do not invent tool names, connect accounts, install helpers, spend money, or broaden access from this document alone. Current operator authorization and native permissions govern every action.

Resolve an already authorized X Money connector. Grok Bot connection screens below are upstream product instructions, not available Codex controls. If no supported native approval surface or X Money tool exists, do not move money. Ask for the exact action using the host permission surface or ordinary conversation and wait for explicit approval; never fabricate an approval field. Preserve the upstream per-action payment approvals and refusal/idempotency rules. Read-only account lookup still needs task-scoped authorization.

replacements.after: Use the supported native approval surface, or ask in ordinary conversation for explicit approval of this exact action. Never simulate a `SendToUser` widget.

replacements.before: Offer the actions that are present. Do not tell the user to reinstall or reconnect.
replacements.after: Offer the actions that are present. Reinstallation or reconnection cannot enable an action disabled for the account.

proof: Deterministic source and adaptation checks; live connector and workflow execution not demonstrated.
